changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The review job recorded a script run of "did not finish" for each practice that capture had excluded from the runner, because Applies when proved it absent or its evidence was not ready. The runner never received those practices, so the rows claim a run that did not happen, and nothing writes them again. Delete only the rows of the job's current attempt that carry no measurement or usage, where the job's capture and the practice's capture decision both exclude the practice and the staged practice index does not name it.
changeSet.sql: -- Every JSON fact is compared as a JSON value, never cast, so a missing or differently typed fact -- keeps the row. jsonb_array_elements gets an empty array when the value is not an array, because -- PostgreSQL does not promise the order in which it evaluates the conditions. DELETE FROM review_job_script_run r USING review_job j, review_practice rp WHERE j.id = r.job_id AND j.workspace_id = r.workspace_id -- review_job.capture holds the facts of the job's current attempt only. AND r.attempt = j.attempt AND rp.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND rp.review_id = j.review_id AND rp.practice_id = r.practice_id AND rp.practice_version_id = r.practice_version_id -- The exact shape that the server wrote for a practice that the runner report did not name. AND r.status = 'NOT_FINISHED' AND r.stop_reason IS NULL AND r.calls IS NULL AND r.models IS NULL AND r.error IS NULL AND r.duration_ms IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_job_script_usage u WHERE u.job_id = r.job_id AND u.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND u.attempt = r.attempt AND u.practice_id = r.practice_id) -- Use the slug retained with the capture decision that staged the practice. AND jsonb_typeof(rp.capture_decision -> 'practiceSlug') = 'string' -- The runner never received the practice. AND jsonb_typeof(j.capture -> 'practices') = 'array' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.capture -> 'practices') = 'array' THEN j.capture -> 'practices' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) staged WHERE staged -> 'slug' = rp.capture_decision -> 'practiceSlug') -- Both frozen records exclude the practice explicitly. AND ( (j.capture -> 'readiness' -> 'applicability' -> (rp.capture_decision ->> 'practiceSlug') -> 'absent' = 'true'::jsonb AND rp.capture_decision -> 'applicability' -> 'absent' = 'true'::jsonb) OR (rp.capture_decision -> 'ready' = 'false'::jsonb AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.capture -> 'readiness' -> 'decisions') = 'array' THEN j.capture -> 'readiness' -> 'decisions' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) decision WHERE decision -> 'practiceSlug' = rp.capture_decision -> 'practiceSlug' AND decision -> 'ready' = 'false'::jsonb)));

rollback.stop: Restore the database backup taken before this upgrade. The deleted script runs recorded no measurement, and the review's capture facts still explain why each practice did not run.
